proposed_capability: Repository-wide Build/Buy host gate: before any room or building structure mutation, require an attested Sims My Library save of that building so human judgment (revert point) is preserved; agents and host callers share the same fail-closed admission.
player_save_control_impact: Does not write user play saves or EA Documents folders from offline code. Records model-bound library-checkpoint attestations only. Live Save-to-My-Library UI remains a separate adapter under screen admission; no silent overwrite of household play saves. Distinct from game Save As (BI_TMP_/BI_CONT_).
expected_outcome: house_state.admit_mutation and host_stack Build/Buy planning deny room/structure mutations unless a fresh library building save attestation exists for the scoped building_id; SAVE_TO_LIBRARY is the only pre-mutation path that creates that attestation; plan_next surfaces LIBRARY_SAVE_REQUIRED first.
negative_tests: SLEDGE or WALL_ROOM_TOOL without library attestation is denied
MOVE_HOUSE_OR_ROOM / MULTI_OBJECT_REARRANGE without library attestation denied
Mutation targeting WALL_SEGMENT or FLOOR_TILE without library attestation denied
Stale library attestation (wrong building_id or older than bound revision) denied
SAVE_TO_LIBRARY itself admitted without prior library save when capture+name present
Outdoor floater inventory alone does not require library save
host_stack Build/Buy turn reports LIBRARY_CHECKPOINT_REQUIRED when room mutate pending without attestation
rollback_path: Revert isolated feature commits; no game library or save files written by offline prototype.
unresolved_unknowns: Exact live Build Mode Save-to-Library click path and confirmation toast remain observation-bound
Library item naming collisions across households need live observation
BI-002 hunger live cert remains independent
